full_page.content:
1946, October 9th
Page 2
Mr. Joseph J. O'Donnell
Incidently, I am not sure if I ever showed that photo. Ic case of neglect on my part heretofore, please remind me when you come the next time and I shall be pleased, as I am sure you will be.
Please pardon if this is getting too drawn-out. I'll try and cach you before you leave for the North.
God bless you again and I want you to bring me something about the conversion of that manager of yours down ther - or of one nearer the ideal.
Sincerely Your in Christ, Fr.Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Praised be Jesus and Our Blessed Mother Mary Fr. Solanus
